results.title: Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi, Farooq Abdullah and other INDIA bloc leaders reach Ramlila Maidan
results.content: INDIA bloc leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra, and Farooq Abdullah, arrived at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan to spearhead the ‘Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao’ protest march. Thousands of supporters converged on the national capital to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged electoral roll irregularities and mass voter deletions.

results.title: Watch: Chennithala demands Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation ahead of INDIA bloc rally
results.content: Congress leader Ramesh Chennithala accused the Election Commission of helping the BJP and alleged that attempts were being made to undermine India’s free and fair electoral system. Speaking at a protest at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan, he demanded the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and said several complaints against him were being examined by the Vigilance Department.
